gameDescriptionHtml:
Mini Racing World is a low poly arcade racing game with a career, car tuning and a open world map to explore!

It has a simple and immediate driving model, but difficult to master.

Game Features

  • It has a simple and immediate driving model, but difficult to master.
  • You can buy new cars with the credits you gain by playing the events. You can also unlock some components by completing certain events.
  • Every car has a different driving style and different components to customize it.
  • Modify your cars by changing color, exhaust, spoilers and other aesthetic components.
  • Improve the perfomance of your vehicle to be able to proceed during the career.
  • Become the Mini Racing World champion by winning seasons and special races.
  • Explore a diverse mini open world to access the events and the garage.
  • 3D low poly graphics with colorful and stylized environment and cars. Vehicles out of proportion for maximum cuteness.
